name: Core loader
responsibility: Loads the renderer core of the installation on this thread and refuses a build made from other sources than the installation expects
description: The core is a build, and Bun does not read it as source. A checkout expects the hash of its own Rust sources, which it computes. A release ships no sources and expects the hash that its marker recorded. A missing core, one that cannot be loaded and one made from other sources are refused with CORE_BUILD_MISSING, CORE_BUILD_INVALID and CORE_BUILD_STALE; the remedy is bun run build:core in a checkout, and reinstalling a release. The module this thread compiled is what each layout worker is handed.

outgoing.label: the core directory, and the hash it must record
